mistakes.title: Bypass capacitor too far from power pin
mistakes.explanation: C1 is 13.3mm from U1 pin 2 (+3V3). Bypass capacitors should be within 3.0mm of the power pin they're decoupling. At 13.3mm, the inductance of the trace reduces filtering effectiveness.
mistakes.fix_suggestion: Move C1 to within 3.0mm of U1 pin 2, with a short, wide trace to both +3V3 and GND.

mistakes.title: Power trace too narrow
mistakes.explanation: Power trace on GND is only 0.25mm wide. Narrow power traces cause voltage drop and can overheat under load. For 1A at 1oz copper, traces should be at least 0.5mm wide.
mistakes.fix_suggestion: Increase trace width on GND to at least 0.3mm, or use a copper pour for power distribution. Consider the expected current draw.
